settings.shortcuts.handsFreeDesc: Best for talking at length: press once to start, press again to stop. Nothing to hold down.
settings.shortcuts.handsFreeHelp:
Which keys can I use?
A single common key (Right Alt, Caps Lock, F1–F12), a modifier + key combination, or a mouse side or middle button. Windows-reserved combinations that lock or switch windows or open system UI can't be bound.

What happens if I bind a mouse button?
Binding a side button takes over its Back and Forward function. Binding the middle button may break opening links in new tabs and autoscroll.
settings.shortcuts.pttDesc: Best for short bursts: recording starts once the whole combination is held down, and stops as soon as you release any key.
settings.shortcuts.pttHelp:
Which keys can I use?
A single common key (Caps Lock, F1–F12), a modifier + key combination, a modifier-only combination such as Ctrl + Win, or a mouse side or middle button. Windows-reserved combinations that lock or switch windows or open system UI can't be bound.

Do modifier-only combinations affect Windows?
Those keys still reach Windows, and some combinations may also open the Start menu. Try your choice in the apps you use most.

What happens if I bind a mouse button?
Binding a side button takes over its Back and Forward function. Binding the middle button may break opening links in new tabs and autoscroll.

textFormat.aiNote: With AI cleanup on, formatting is left to the AI and this option does nothing (so the two don't fight).
textFormat.desc: Applies only in fast mode with AI cleanup off. With AI cleanup on, formatting is left to the AI.
textFormat.autoSegment.title: Auto paragraphs
textFormat.autoSegment.hint: Splits one long stretch of speech into paragraphs by meaning
textFormat.autoSegment.help:
Uses topic shifts and end-of-sentence pauses to split an unbroken transcript into paragraphs, which is easier to read.

On by default.
textFormat.normalizeNumbers.title: Normalize numbers
textFormat.normalizeNumbers.hint: Rewrites spelled-out Chinese numbers as digits, e.g. 三点一四 → 3.14, 百分之十五 → 15%
textFormat.normalizeNumbers.help:
Rewrites Chinese numbers that were spoken aloud into digits, which suits technical and data-heavy text better. Only converts when the intent is clear — it's best-effort.

三点一四 → 3.14
百分之十五 → 15%
GPT五点四 → GPT 5.4
扩容二十三台 → 扩容23台
两百五 → 250

To avoid false positives, a bare 一二三, set phrases such as 十全十美, and digit-by-digit numbers are left alone.
textFormat.stripTrailing.title: Drop end punctuation
textFormat.stripTrailing.hint: Removes punctuation at the end of each paragraph, keeping punctuation inside sentences
textFormat.stripTrailing.help:
Removes only the punctuation at the end of each paragraph. Punctuation inside a sentence, such as commas, stays. Handy when you paste transcripts straight into a chat box and don't want a trailing period.

With multiple paragraphs, every paragraph is handled, not just the last one.

你好，世界。→ 你好，世界
真的吗？！→ 真的吗
第一段。↵第二段！→ 第一段↵第二段
textFormat.punctuationToSpace.title: Punctuation to spaces
textFormat.punctuationToSpace.hint: Replaces all punctuation with spaces, e.g. 你好，世界！→ 你好 世界
textFormat.punctuationToSpace.help:
Replaces every punctuation mark with a space, collapses repeated spaces and trims the ends. Useful for keywords, search terms, or pasting somewhere that shouldn't carry punctuation. Decimal points and percent signs inside numbers are kept.

你好，世界！→ 你好 世界
第一，先做A；第二，再做B。→ 第一 先做A 第二 再做B
准确率是99.5%。→ 准确率是99.5%

err.download.checksum: The file failed its checksum, so what arrived is incomplete. Try another download source.

server.title: Server address
server.desc: Enter your SayIt server address. The app connects after you save.
server.help:
The default address, sayitapp.site, is a free trial server run by the author with speech recognition and AI already set up, so you can try SayIt quickly.
Running it costs money, so it isn't guaranteed to stay available.
For everyday use, run recognition locally, bring your own Doubao API key, or host the backend yourself.

release.0.1.7.1: The interface is now available in English and follows your system language by default. You can also choose Auto / 中文 / English under Settings → General; this changes interface text only, not the language spoken recognition expects
release.0.1.7.2: Two English models were added to local recognition: Parakeet Unified EN, the fastest and most accurate option for English but English only, and Nemotron 3.5 ASR, which covers 32 languages for mixed-language speech
release.0.1.7.3: Added Groq, available for AI cleanup and as a speech recognition service: recognition uses whisper-large-v3-turbo, which is multilingual and fast. Both require access to the international internet
release.0.1.7.4: Updates no longer interrupt you: a new version downloads quietly in the background, then the About icon in the sidebar turns green so you can install it when convenient. Skipping it costs nothing either, since SayIt finishes the update the next time you close the app
release.0.1.7.5: Push-to-talk no longer accepts Shift, and the default key is now right Ctrl: holding Shift triggers the Windows Filter Keys shortcut, after which recording does not stop when you let go. Existing Shift bindings keep working
release.0.1.7.6: Fixed updates never arriving after you pointed the backend address at your own server, which is where the update check used to look
release.0.1.7.7: Fixed every provider 403 being reported as a rejected key: the more common causes are the service not being offered in your region, or the model not being enabled for your account
release.0.1.7.8: Dictation starts faster: the overlay is prepared shortly after launch, pressing the shortcut shows it before the target window is probed, and the two window scans were merged into one. Hands-free now switches on key down instead of waiting for the release
release.0.1.7.9: With AI cleanup off, half-width commas and question marks that follow a Chinese character are converted to their full-width form, so punctuation width stays consistent
